comment.zh-TW: 主因是強風。10/27 08–20 時兩格六個模式中三個認為中以上，德國模式陣風約 37 節，日本模式與美國 AI 模式估算陣風達 51.9 節；但歐洲模式與美國模式陣風僅 32–37 節，陣風超過 49 節的機率 0%，陣風超過 29 節的機率 100%。其餘時段偏低，判中。

comment.en: Strong wind is the main cause. For 10/27 08:00–20:00, three of six models say Medium or above: the German model shows gusts near 37 kt, and the Japanese model and US AI model show estimated gusts up to 51.9 kt. But the European and US models show gusts of only 32–37 kt, with a 0% chance of gusts over 49 kt and a 100% chance of gusts over 29 kt. Other periods are low, so Medium.

comment.zh-CN: 未来五天停飞风险为中，主因是强风／侧风。10/27 08–20 时风力最强，阵风超过 29 节的概率达 100%，六个模式中三个认为中以上，其中德国模式阵风达 37.1 至 37.5 节，美国 AI 模式与日本模式估算阵风达 47.9 至 51.9 节、侧风达 20.9 至 30.2 节；欧洲模式与美国模式阵风则为 32.1 至 36.8 节，且阵风超过 49 节的概率为 0%。其余时段多数模式评估为低。
comment.en: The disruption risk over the next five days is Medium, mainly due to strong winds and crosswinds. Winds peak during 10/27 08–20 h local, with a 100% chance of gusts over 29 kt and three of six models indicating Medium or above: the German model forecasts gusts of 37.1–37.5 kt, while the US AI model and Japanese model show estimated gusts of 47.9–51.9 kt and crosswinds of 20.9–30.2 kt; however, the European model and US model forecast gusts of 32.1–36.8 kt, with a 0% chance of gusts over 49 kt. Most models rate other periods as Low.

comment.en: The main cause is fog/low cloud, but the evidence is thin. 16 of 20 periods show Medium, all from the US model's visibility, e.g. visibility 35 m on 10/25 08:00-14:00; no other model provides visibility to confirm it. Gusts peak at only 19 kt in the European model, with a 0% chance of gusts over 29 kt; rain is at most 9 mm in 6 hours, and there is no airport forecast or airport observation, so the disruption risk is rated Low.

comment.en: The disruption risk over the next five days is mainly driven by dense fog/low clouds and is rated Medium. As only the US model provides visibility data, it forecasts low visibility of 35 to 304 m across 16 periods, including 10/25 02:00 to 10/27 02:00 and 08:00–20:00 from 10/27 to 10/29 (down to 35 m during 10/25 08:00–20:00). For wind and rain, the models agree on Low risk, with gusts up to 19 kt, 6-hour rainfall up to 9 mm, and a 0% chance of gusts over 29 kt or 24-hour rainfall over 50 mm.

comment.zh-HK: 主因是強風／側風。機場預報（TAF）在 10/25 02–14 時給出平均風 19 節、陣風 35 節、側風 32.2 節，接近高門檻，颱風藍色預警亦仍然生效。不過八個模式全部判低，陣風或估算陣風只有 23.5–31.2 節，陣風超過 49 節的機率 0%；機場觀測（METAR）04 時平均風僅 12 節。依機場預報維持中，10/25 14 時後轉低。
comment.zh-CN: 主因是强风／侧风。机场预报（TAF）在 10/25 02–14 时给出平均风 19 节、阵风 35 节、侧风 32.2 节，接近高门槛，台风蓝色预警也仍在生效。不过八个模式全判低，阵风或估算阵风只有 23.5–31.2 节，阵风超过 49 节的概率 0%；机场观测（METAR）04 时平均风仅 12 节。依机场预报维持中，10/25 14 时后转低。
comment.en: The main cause is strong wind and crosswind. The airport forecast (TAF) for 10/25 02:00-14:00 gives a mean wind of 19 kt, gusts of 35 kt and a crosswind of 32.2 kt, close to the High threshold, and the typhoon blue warning is still in effect. However, all eight models say Low, with gusts or estimated gusts of only 23.5-31.2 kt and a 0% chance of gusts over 49 kt; the airport observation (METAR) at 04:00 shows a mean wind of just 12 kt. comment.en: The 5-day disruption risk is Medium, mainly due to strong winds and crosswinds. During 10/28 09–15 h local, 3 of 6 models indicate Medium: the US model shows gusts of 38.7 kt, the German model 37.3 kt, and the US AI model estimated gusts of 39.3 kt; the European model shows gusts of only 28.5 kt, while the European ensemble gives a 57% chance of gusts over 29 kt. Other periods, such as 10/25 03–15 h local with light rain, mist, and visibility of 3000 m in the airport forecast (TAF), have a Low overall risk.

comment.en: Disruption risk over the next five days is Medium, mainly due to strong winds/crosswind and heavy rain/thunderstorms. From 10/25 03:00 to 10/26 09:00 local, the airport forecast (TAF) shows gusts of 35 kt, light rain, and visibility of 4000 to 6000 m, rating it Low; however, models rate it Medium, with a 94% to 97% chance of 24-hour rainfall over 50 mm during 10/25 03:00–15:00, up to 48.8 mm of rain in 6 hours in the European model, gusts of 37 kt with a 100% chance of gusts over 29 kt during 10/25 15:00–21:00, and visibility of 596 m in the US model from 10/25 21:00 to 10/26 09:00. Risk drops to Low from 10/26 09:00.
